data.title: Witness summons from Amtsgericht Musterquedlin
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterquedlin summons Uwe Beispielharz as a witness (Zeuge) in the civil case Beispielharz Dachbau GmbH vs. Marion Kessler regarding unpaid work fees (Werklohn). The hearing is scheduled for Wednesday, 13 January 2027 at 09:00 in Saal 104 of the court.
data.explanation: You are being called as a witness in a civil lawsuit between two other parties; you are not being sued yourself. You must appear at the court on the stated date and time, bringing this summons and an official ID. The hearing concerns the roof work done at Bodetal 6 in May 2026. If you fail to appear without a sufficient excuse, you could be charged the costs this causes and a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under § 380 ZPO. Travel costs and lost earnings can be compensated under the JVEG. If you cannot attend, contact the court beforehand to explain and possibly reschedule.
